name: germany_france_1940
description: Germany (A) invades the Netherlands, Belgium, Luxembourg and France, May-June 1940, at state granularity. Real states, adjacency, terrain and rivers from the 1.19.5 map; the force counts, hubs, objectives and time limit are assumptions of ours. Held out of every training run of the learned plan chooser.
assumptions: Sides: the ten western German states are side A; the Netherlands, Belgium, Luxembourg and the French states north of the Midi are side B (British and other allied forces are folded into B). Switzerland, Italy, Spain and the coast overseas are left out, so no flank beyond the three countries is modelled.

Forces are about 40 percent of the historical order of battle: 23 German divisions (18 infantry, 5 armour, the armour in Moselland and Rhineland, facing the Ardennes) against 25 allied infantry. The sim's inf_9 and armor_6 templates; the Maginot Line, French equipment, the BEF and air power are not modelled.
Hubs: Hessen for Germany; Ile de France for the Allies, so Dutch and Belgian states are in supply only through France.
Objectives and limit: take Antwerp, Picardy, Champagne and Ile de France within 40 days. The historical campaign took Paris in 36 days; the objective set and the limit are ours.
Rivers come from map/rivers.bmp by a threshold heuristic of ours (realmap.py), not a game rule.
One simulator province per state, 12 hour steps.
